recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-19252 unless a future final OO issue changes DiagnosticReport.category semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-19252 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised against STU3 DiagnosticReport. It asked to increase DiagnosticReport.category cardinality to support multiple category axes such as clinical-note, radiology, and interventional-radiology, and the final resolution required adding a comment that multiple categories are allowed using various categorization schemes.
initial_application: Commit 20e0ca6e39aad6517e01939795abde3c11038920 pre-applied GF#19252 by changing the old DiagnosticReport spreadsheet source for DiagnosticReport.category from 0..1 to 0..* and adding the requested multiple-category comment. Later source rework migrated that content into the current XML StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists diagnosticreport as an active resource owned by OO, so source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml is in current build scope. The current StructureDefinition has DiagnosticReport.category at 0..* with the requested comment, and the event mapping exception source carries the same comment. OO block-vote evidence lists GF#19252 as Persuasive and approved 5-0-1. Bounded Jira, Zulip, Confluence, and history checks did not reveal a later conflicting core decision; the existing FHIR-20337 audit mentions FHIR-19252 only as background.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed: the current authoritative DiagnosticReport source already implements the final Jira request.
